title: Evaluated free nerve exactness
statement: For every object X, evaluation of the free module presheaf nerve is exact in positive degrees.

proof.text: For any map of sets g:A→B, replace B by Set.range g. Set.rangeFactorization g is surjective. Equality of g-images is equivalent to equality in the range, using Subtype.ext and congrArg Subtype.val. Thus nerveRangeEquiv gives equivalences of compatible tuples, extended by Finsupp.domLCongr to nerveRangeLinearEquiv. These commute with alternating differentials because deleting a coordinate keeps the underlying tuple. Apply setCechNerve_free_resolution to the surjection onto the range, take its positive-degree range/kernel equalities, and transfer them using Function.Exact.iff_of_ladder_linearEquiv. No surjectivity of g is needed, including empty A and empty fibres.

Evaluation at X preserves the wide pullbacks defining nerve degrees. Types.isLimitEquivSections identifies the evaluated limit with sections of the evaluated wide cospan. A section is uniquely a compatible tuple: retain its components at some i, and reconstruct its component at none as g(a₀). This constructs evaluatedNerveEquiv and its inverse. WidePullback.lift_π identifies projection after a face with deletion of that coordinate, proving evaluatedNerveEquiv_face.

Extend evaluatedNerveEquiv linearly by Finsupp.domLCongr. Evaluation of the free presheaf module is the free module on the evaluated set. Evaluation preserves finite sums and integer multiples, so its differential is the alternating sum of free maps on evaluated faces. On each free generator with coefficient r, evaluatedNerveEquiv_face identifies the face terms with setCechDifferential. The coefficient (-1)^j commutes with r even in a noncommutative ring, by Commute.neg_one_left and pow_left. This proves evaluatedNerveLinearEquiv_d.

Rewrite ExactAt (n+1) as exactness of the short complex at indices n+2, n+1, n. ShortComplex.moduleCat_exact_iff_range_eq_ker expresses this as linear range/kernel equality. Transfer positive exactness from step 1 along evaluatedNerveLinearEquiv and its differential identities using Function.Exact.iff_of_ladder_linearEquiv.
